mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm so glad you're here. Imagine stepping inside a story where addiction isn't just a distant problem, but a daily battle—raw, honest, and deeply personal. That's exactly what we experience in Dry, brought to life by Augusten Burroughs. Together, we'll walk with him through the relentless ups and downs of alcoholism—where every day feels like a tug-of-war between pain and hope. You'll notice the journey isn't just about giving something up—it's about confronting your own vulnerabilities, about finding moments of laughter and heartbreak, and about searching for meaning when things seem most chaotic. Along the way, relationships are put to the test. Old wounds open up, and the road to recovery turns into a patchwork of setbacks and hard-won victories. Picture the high-pressure world of advertising—the demands, the temptations—and how it all becomes the backdrop for one person's transformation. What makes Dry stand out is the way it invites us to reflect on dependence, courage, and the connections that keep us going. This isn't just a story about sobriety. It's about learning to live—and to really feel—even when life hurts. So, if you're ready, let's explore this journey together and discover what it truly means to find hope and healing, one day at a time.
